institution.name: International Max Planck Research School for Intelligent Systems (IMPRS-IS)

field: Intelligent systems: machine learning, robotics, computer vision, human-computer interaction
description_short: IMPRS-IS, run by the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems with the Universities of Stuttgart and Tübingen, accepts doctoral applications for starts from February 2027. Applicants submit a two-page motivational letter and three referees, whose letters are due by the deadline.
